collection.description: A child asks why an adult often chooses to spend time by themself.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks why (loner) often chooses to spend time by themself.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (carer), a caregiver, says some people enjoy quiet and solitude.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) learns that being alone does not always mean being lonely.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (loner) says they would rather not talk, and (child) respects it.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child) learns to ask before joining someone.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) realizes that friendship does not require constant company.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) notices that they sometimes want quiet too.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) invites a friend to play later instead.
